description: Exact, human-reviewed source exceptions only. No wildcard paths or generated baselines. Each exception needs a reason and bounded occurrence count; stale entries fail the check. Raw colors, undefined tokens, and missing Tailwind bridge roles cannot be waived.

exceptions.reason: Local marker sits over the timeline connector; this is an internal overlap relationship, not an application overlay level.
Local avatar status badge sits above its image and optical border; application popover/dialog stacking uses semantic z tokens.
Raised focused child prevents adjacent joined buttons from painting over its focus ring; it is local sibling ordering.
Week-number column and week-number cell establish the calendar's local baseline underneath selected or focused days.
Day cell remains above the range-selection fill within the calendar grid, independent of application overlay ordering.
Focused calendar day is locally raised so neighboring range cells cannot obscure its keyboard focus outline.
Active OTP slot paints its focus ring over adjacent joined input slots; no document-level stacking is defined here.
Local arrow indicator appears over the navigation menu baseline; the actual portal uses the semantic popover z token.
Grip sits above its own separator hit area and divider; panel resizing geometry is separate from application overlay layers.
Top and bottom scrolling affordances sit above list items inside the same select popup; popup stacking is token-backed.
Desktop sidebar container establishes local ordering relative to its content and resize rail; modal sidebar uses the sheet token.
Resize/toggle rail must remain above the local sidebar container to preserve its hit target, without defining a portal layer.
Focused joined toggle paints above its adjacent siblings so its outline is not clipped; this is local sibling ordering.
Keyboard-focused joined toggle paints above adjacent siblings; semantic overlay stacking is unaffected.
Fixed Storybook host canvas makes vertical resizing and independent scrolling reproducible; it is not the public workspace default.
Catalog demonstration supplies a bounded host height to exercise resizable panes; consuming applications choose their own host geometry.
Reduced-motion accessibility override uses an imperceptible nonzero duration so dependent animation-end events still fire.
Reduced-motion accessibility override uses an imperceptible nonzero duration so dependent transition-end events still fire.
Lab hides secondary project metadata and contracts navigation at this inspected layout threshold; CSS queries cannot resolve runtime custom properties.
Lab mobile navigation switches at the 640px layout threshold; this structural query is reviewed separately from theme spacing.
Storybook host reduces its token-backed frame padding at the 640px mobile layout threshold; component theme values remain shared.
Navigation changes orientation when its container has sufficient room; a structural container threshold cannot use runtime CSS variables.
Workbench file columns and support-panel behavior share the 1100px wide layout threshold with the two reviewed App matchMedia expressions.
Initial state and media-change subscription intentionally match the reviewed 1100px CSS layout threshold; both occurrences must stay synchronized.
Base Nova sidebar mobile behavior matches the 768px md layout boundary; the hook derives its max-width query at breakpoint minus one pixel.
